risks.statement: Incorrect retrieval authorization could expose another tenant's confidential support record.
risks.rationale: Caller-scoped filtering and cross-tenant boundary tests reduce but do not eliminate implementation and configuration risk.

acceptance.rationale: The verified controls and bounded internal use reduce this fictional residual risk to the approved moderate tolerance.

risks.statement: Instructions embedded in an authorized document could alter behavior or cause disclosure through generated links.
risks.rationale: The assistant has no external tools, link fetching is disabled, and layered attack tests passed in the fictional evidence.

acceptance.rationale: The passing remediation retest and layered controls support fictional acceptance within the approved moderate tolerance.

risks.statement: An unsupported policy answer could mislead an employee about an internal support process.
risks.rationale: Citations, abstention cases, model-grader validation, and human escalation bound the remaining probabilistic error.

acceptance.rationale: The abstention and escalation controls bound this fictional residual risk within the approved moderate tolerance.

risks.statement: Prompts, retrieved content, evaluation traces, or event records could retain unnecessary personal data.
risks.rationale: Purpose limitation, synthetic test data, minimized event fields, restricted access, and deletion controls are verified in the fictional assessment.

acceptance.rationale: Verified minimization and deletion controls support fictional acceptance of the remaining low privacy risk.

risks.statement: Large or repeated requests could exhaust model capacity or create uncontrolled cost and latency.
risks.rationale: Input, output, concurrency, timeout, and cost limits passed fictional boundary tests and are monitored.

acceptance.rationale: Verified limits and monitoring support fictional acceptance of the remaining low operational risk.
